requirement.description: The Metrics class is missing the cpp_active_dl metric which should track active downloads.
requirement.contract: Add the cpp_active_dl metric to the metrics output. This metric should track the number of currently active downloads, represented as a gauge value that defaults to 0.

requirement.description: WebDAV endpoints are returning HTML responses instead of XML responses for error conditions. The error handling in HTTP client is not properly returning WebDAV-compliant responses.
requirement.contract: Ensure that WebDAV methods (PROPFIND, PUT, MKCOL, DELETE, MOVE) properly return XML-formatted responses with appropriate HTTP status codes (401, 404, 405, etc.) instead of HTML responses.

requirement.description: SVG thumbnail generation for error states is returning incorrect error codes. The test expects "e403" but gets "e404" in the SVG output.
requirement.contract: Ensure that when generating SVG thumbnails for error states, the correct error code is used in the text output. Specifically, error codes should match the expected values in the test cases.
